articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Shein shares fall 10% amid urgent recall of contact-lens cleaner by Australia, New Zealand
articles.description: Shein's Hong Kong-listed shares fell as much as 10%, amid news that a contact lens product has been recalled urgently due to worries of contamination.

articles.title: King Charles to host AI chiefs amid industry call to slow development
articles.description: The gathering comes days after Dario Amodei and Sam Altman called for greater restraint at the AI frontier, warning that rapidly improving systems could pose increasingly difficult-to-control risks.

articles.title: LA Clippers owner Steve Ballmer apologizes over team sanctions
articles.description: Ballmer said that the team is complying with the penalties, has paid the fines, and is "moving forward."

articles.title: Robinhood CEO says issuers should not have veto over tokenized stocks
articles.description: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev said issuers should be involved if tokenized products change shareholder rights or company obligations, but not when they create separate instruments backed by shares.

articles.title: Cadbury cut two months off its supply chain lead time for a key chocolate-bar ingredient in one move
articles.description: Mondelez is expanding its chocolate manufacturing operations in Malaysia, with the company also seeing further room for growth across Southeast Asia.

articles.title: Anthropic walks tightrope to Nasdaq, pushing for a slowdown while pursuing $2 trillion valuation
articles.description: As Anthropic meets with prospective investors ahead of its potentially historic market debut, CEO Dario Amodei is pushing for a slowdown in AI.

articles.title: Baker Hughes sees no slowdown in energy projects despite higher rates as AI buildouts stoke LNG demand
articles.description: Baker Hughes has yet to see higher borrowing costs slow investment in major energy projects.

articles.title: US Republicans send ‘final’ CLARITY Act offer to Democrats
articles.description: The 635-page revised proposal includes Trump-backed ethics provisions and comes just two days before a key procedural vote.

articles.title: Z.ai shares tumble over 10% after $5 billion fundraising, its second major raise in two months
articles.description: Z.ai shares tumbled after the Chinese AI company announced its second major fundraising in two months.

articles.title: Trump says U.S. may keep Iranian oil 'like Venezuela' as Gulf-Iran Hormuz talks stall
articles.description: Trump said revenue from the Venezuela arrangement has "paid for the war many times."

articles.title: The 10-year Treasury is closing in on 5%. How it gets there matters more
articles.description: The 10-year Treasury yield is closing in on 5%, a level last touched in October 2023. Strategists say the drivers behind higher yields are more important.

articles.title: Prediction markets are becoming more professionalized, but also harder to beat
articles.description: The institutionalization of prediction markets threatens to erode the edge of skilled traders who earn off mispricing and market inefficiencies, experts say.

articles.title: Revolut attackers threaten daily customer data leaks
articles.description: Attackers reportedly published identity documents and selfies belonging to Revolut customers and threatened to release more data each day until the fintech pays.

articles.title: Crypto’s biggest week ever? Swarm fears prompt AI slowdown: Hodler’s Digest
articles.description: Crypto’s moment of CLARITY finally arrives with a key Senate vote on Tuesday. AI swarm fears prompt development slowdown, with some predicting big falls in AI stock prices.

articles.title: Jim Cramer questions Anthropic CEO's slowdown manifesto and puts forth an action plan
articles.description: While I have grown tired of his endless proclamations, Dario Amodei does raise points that will impact many stocks if the spending curb proceeds.

articles.title: OpenAI rules out IPO this year as Altman, Musk & Amodei warn AI is moving too fast
articles.description: Altman's IPO comments and Amodei's public call for more careful pacing of AI development cap a week of loud AI warnings.

articles.title: Is Clarity dead? A vibes-based analysis: State of Crypto
articles.description: I dunno, flip a coin.

articles.title: Washington scrambles to meet calls for AI guardrails while the window to act closes
articles.description: The House is scheduled to be sent home in the coming days until after November's midterm elections, leaving a narrow window to pass any form of AI regulation.

articles.title: Quantum-proof blockchain: why math, not machines, holds the key
articles.description: lockchains don’t need quantum computers to be quantum-safe, argues Optimum co-founder and MIT professor Muriel Médard. Classic math already gives us the tools.
